Card Q&A.a: "When [...] would leave the battle area" refers to when this Digimon is placed in the trash, returned to the hand/deck, placed in the security stack, moved to the breeding area, or placed under another card.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's "when [...] would leave the battle area" mean, exactly?

Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would leave the battle area, you may place up to 3 Digimon cards with the [Xros Heart] trait from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.
Special Play Condition: [Starmons] When this would be played, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each one reduces the play cost.
